Turkish Police Raid Opposition TV Station Halk TV

Turkish police raided the offices of the pro-opposition television channel Halk TV in Istanbul, taking it off the air and arresting 11 individuals. This action is described as the latest in a series of crackdowns on media critical of the Turkish president and his government.
